decisive_items: Initial shave biopsy revealed nodular BCC of the left cheek
elevated, pearly lesion on the left lower eyelid
infiltrative pattern with no signs of fibrosis or inflammatory infiltrate
response.rationale: Biopsy-proven nodular and infiltrative BCC directly answers the diagnosis; ectropion and socket changes are secondary complications.

rejected.why: Describes cicatricial changes but is a consequence of the underlying malignancy, not the primary diagnosis.
Anophthalmic socket syndrome is a background condition, not the cause of the new growing lesion.
